title: Plumb runtime branch scope into flat-file providers
description: Carry the actual runtime branch scope from cli.providerAndContextForInvocation through app.NewProvider into the flat-file Provider while leaving Trello behavior unchanged. Store an optional immutable invocation scope on each flat-file provider so creation and readiness can consume it later. Preserve help/version/schema commands that intentionally avoid provider initialization, keep nested-directory and linked-worktree discovery semantics, and update factory/CLI tests and test constructors without changing allocation or scheduling yet. Scope must be based on the checked-out branch, never task metadata flags. Keep the repository compiling throughout this slice.
